naming: one unique run directory per invocation; stable role filenames inside the run directory

artifacts.proofCeiling: exact bytes supplied to both preflight and execution; local-only and potentially sensitive
prompt digest, source class, preflight/execute exit codes, paths, and ordering observed by the harness runner
human rendering of the same harness-owned continuity evidence

retention: Keep the run-local prompt only as long as needed for retry/recovery. Never commit it. Delete the run directory after acceptance if the prompt contains private operational context.
secretRule: Do not use this transport for passwords, tokens, recovery codes, private keys, or other credentials.
